title: The Truth about Hydrogen
summary: Real Engineering examines the efficiency of hydrogen as an energy carrier. It follows production, storage and fuel cell conversion losses and compares hydrogen cars with battery electric vehicles.
why: HN links it in hydrogen threads as a clear breakdown of why compounded inefficiencies make hydrogen a poor fit for cars, though one commenter calls it outdated.

quote.text: This video gives a good breakdown on how the inefficiencies in hydrogen fuel cell based cars add up.
